recipe_version.title: Lebanese Arayes: Spiced Lamb-Stuffed Pita with Tahini Sauce
recipe_version.description: Pita halves filled with a thin layer of ground lamb mixed with grated onion, parsley, garlic, allspice, cinnamon, cumin, and Aleppo pepper, brushed with olive oil and baked crisp, served with a lemony tahini sauce, sliced cucumber, and radishes.

ingredients.name: pita
ingredients.display_name: 7-inch pocket pitas whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, sugar, and salt

ingredients.name: tahini
ingredients.display_name: tahini whose label lists sesame seeds

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Grate the onion on the box grater and squeeze it dry, chop the parsley, grate the garlic, and halve the pitas.

steps.title: Stuff the pitas
steps.body: In the large bowl, mix the lamb, onion, parsley, 2 cloves garlic, allspice, cinnamon, cumin, Aleppo pepper, and 1 1/4 tsp salt. Open each pita half and spread an even 1/4-inch layer of filling inside, pressing it flat. Brush the outsides with the oil and set 4 on each sheet pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake 8 minutes, flip with the thin spatula, switch the pans, and bake until crisp and the filling is 160 F, about 8 minutes more.

steps.title: Tahini sauce and vegetables
steps.body: While the arayes bake (overlap stated): whisk the tahini, lemon juice, 1 clove garlic, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 cup cold water in the small bowl until smooth and pourable. Slice the cucumber and halve the radishes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cut each half in two and serve hot with the tahini sauce for dipping, cucumber, and radishes.

coverage_contribution: Lebanese food in the catalog is baked kibbeh and samke harra; there is no stuffed bread. A crisp, hand-held lamb dinner.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with turkish-lahmacun: lamb sealed inside pita and baked crisp, not spread thin over open dough. Compared with lebanese-baked-kibbeh: a raw lamb filling baked in bread, not a bulgur and lamb layered bake. Compared with sabich-pita-sandwiches: a hot baked lamb pocket, not eggplant and egg in pita.
not_duplicate_of: Not a gyro and not kofta in pita. Unlike pakistani-lamb-keema-peas and balkan-cevapi-ajvar in this wave, the raw spiced lamb is baked inside the bread.
